_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: OAuth is only needed to publish an integration. For one workspace an access token is the documented and simpler route.
Read scopes only: a CRM an agent can write is a CRM a misread field corrupts quietly, and the damage is discovered months later in a report.
